text:
rachel: quick check 11 on invite drawer - in orgs with SSO enforced we currently disable the 'assign roles' CTA and show tooltip 'Restricted by SSO'. design wants a clearer affordance. thought: clicking the disabled CTA could deep-link to audit log filtered to 'invite.role' events or open a small help flyout. which is better?
omar: deep-link feels product-y and useful. if someone sees a role is disabled they probably want to know why it changed. pre-filtered audit log gives context.
jin: agree on value but worried about focus and announcements. a11y: opening audit log as a target needs keyboard focus landing and a visible skip link back to the invite drawer. also disabled controls should be `aria-disabled` not removed from tab order.
tara: copywise we should avoid 'Restricted by SSO' as it's terse. suggestion: tooltip = "Role assignment managed by your identity provider. See audit history or contact your org admin." shorter variant: "Managed by SSO 1 contact admin."
nobody: +1 to clarity. also can we show a tiny inline hint under the CTA in the drawer for first-time users?
omar: implementation note: deep-linking to audit with query params like `/audit?event=invite.role&role=Admin` is straightforward. flyout with inline help would require additional copy approvals and an extra endpoint for inline help content.
jin: for accessibility the deep-link must include `aria-label="Open audit log: role Admin"` and we should set `role="link"` if it's a link. If we keep the CTA as a button and disabled, we can make the audit link separate, visible but low prominence. That avoids turning a disabled control into an action.
a11y-bot: automated scan: invite-drawer frame L3 - flagged: disabled button lacks `aria-disabled` and is removed from tab sequence. Recommend set `tabindex="0"` and `aria-disabled="true"` OR keep `tabindex="-1"` and add a sibling link with clear accessible name. Contrast ok.
rachel: good call. my concern is UX noise - too many visible links in drawer will clutter. proposal: show a secondary text link 'View audit history' beneath CTA. CTA remains disabled visually but not focusable. link is keyboard-focusable.
tara: copy for the audit link: "View audit history for this role". also we should show a small badge when SSO is on: "SSO managed" which opens a modal with explanation.
omar: badge + link seems ok. badge could be lightweight and non-interactive or open modal if clicked. if it opens modal we need to ensure it's not modal-heavy. prefer non-modal explanation inline + link.
jin: engineering constraints: adding a link and a small badge is low lift. modal requires i18n copy and acceptance criteria. accessibility: if badge is interactive use `button` semantics and trap focus in modal. probably avoid trap for now.
rachel: decision draft: 1) Keep CTA disabled (visually distinct) with `aria-disabled=true`. 2) Add secondary link "View audit history for this role" under CTA that deep-links to /audit with filters. 3) Add a non-interactive inline label "SSO managed" with tooltip that explains enforcement; tooltip text varies by org.sso_mode. 4) Avoid modal for this iteration.
tara: +1. can we get final copy strings from product? I'll author: primary tooltip: "Role assignments are controlled by your identity provider. Contact your admin to change access." audit link text: "View audit history for this role" badge tooltip short: "Managed by SSO".
a11y-bot: automated check after changes: recommend removing `title` attributes as sole tooltip; use accessible tooltip pattern with `aria-describedby`. Also ensure the audit link announces filter parameters, e.g., `aria-label="Open audit history filtered to role Admin and invites"`.
mar: small nit: if the invite drawer shows multiple roles we should make the audit link include role param for each chip or show a single aggregated link.
omar: agree - for multi-select show aggregated message 'View audit history for selected roles'.
rachel: timeline: jin/omar can implement link + aria props next sprint if we get copy by EOD Thursday. tara to update figma with badge + link placement. I'll post the mock and copy in this thread when ready.
jin: assigned. will also add unit tests to ensure link contains correct query params.
ra11y-bot: final: accessibility checklist - disabled control must have `aria-disabled`, audit link must be reachable by keyboard, include descriptive aria-label, tooltip implemented with `aria-describedby`, and focus management documented.
tara: thanks team. i'll push the updated drawer frames and a compact desktop/mobile variant by EOD Thursday. :spiral_calendar:
